Our Expertise

Expert In AI Solutions Transforming Retail Experiences

Our Approach

At the heart of our approach is a rigorous assessment process used to identify and prioritize use cases based on their potential impact and feasibility. This meticulous evaluation has led us to focus on developing core retail solutions that include:

  • Customer Value Management Analytics
  • Assortment Optimization
  • Promotion Effectiveness
  • Inventory Forecasting
  • Workforce Optimization

By developing these solutions in-house, we aim to foster seamless integration, tailor them to meet MAFR's specific needs, ensure long-term sustainability, and optimize costs.

Our RACE team’s solutions have been thoroughly evaluated by leading external consulting firms, independent consultants, and our internal teams. These comprehensive assessments consistently confirm that our in-house solutions provide a robust foundation for achieving our objectives.
